method.method_draft: Use a coordinate/projection setup. Read from the diagram that PQ and SR are the two horizontal parallel bases, with S left of R and P left of Q. From the text, set RS=SP=a and PQ=3a, with angle RSP=120°. Place S=(0,0) and R=(a,0), so SR is horizontal. Since SP has length a and makes a 120° interior angle with SR toward the lower-left, P=(-a/2,-sqrt(3)a/2). Because PQ is parallel to SR and has length 3a, Q=P+(3a,0)=(5a/2,-sqrt(3)a/2). Then at Q, vector QP=(-3a,0) and vector QR=(-3a/2,sqrt(3)a/2). The angle between the leftward horizontal QP and QR has tangent (sqrt(3)a/2)/(3a/2)=1/sqrt(3), so angle PQR=30°.

按坐标法设 RS = SP = a，则 PQ = 3a。取 S = (0,0)，R = (a,0)，使 SR 水平向右。因为 SP 长为 a，且从 SR 到 SP 的内角为 120°，所以 P 在左下方，坐标为 P = (-a/2, -√3a/2)。又因为 PQ ∥ SR 且 PQ = 3a，所以 Q = P + (3a,0) = (5a/2, -√3a/2)。

在 Q 点，向量 QP = P - Q = (-3a,0)，是水平向左；向量 QR = R - Q = (-3a/2, √3a/2)。因此 QR 相对于水平向左方向的夹角满足 tan θ = (√3a/2)/(3a/2) = 1/√3，所以 θ = 30°。故 ∠PQR = 30°。

method.method_draft: Use a synthetic triangle argument. Let RS=SP=a, so PQ=3a. Since triangle RSP has RS=SP and included angle RSP=120°, it is isosceles with base angles 30° at R and P, and by the cosine rule PR^2=a^2+a^2-2a^2 cos120°=3a^2, so PR=sqrt(3)a. Because PQ is parallel to SR, the angle SPQ is supplementary to angle RSP, so angle SPQ=60°. Since angle RPS=30° from the isosceles triangle, angle QPR=60°-30°=30°. Now in triangle PQR, apply the cosine rule using PQ=3a, PR=sqrt(3)a, and included angle QPR=30°: QR^2=9a^2+3a^2-2(3a)(sqrt(3)a)cos30°=3a^2, so QR=sqrt(3)a=PR. Therefore triangle PQR is isosceles with base PQ, so angle PQR=angle QPR=30°.

推理：设 RS = SP = a，则 PQ = 3a。因为三角形 RSP 中 RS = SP，且夹角 ∠RSP = 120°，所以它是等腰三角形，底角为 (180° - 120°)/2 = 30°，即 ∠SRP = ∠RPS = 30°。由余弦定理，PR² = a² + a² - 2a²cos120° = 2a² + a² = 3a²，所以 PR = √3a。又因为 PQ ∥ SR，所以同旁内角互补，∠SPQ = 180° - 120° = 60°。在 P 点，∠RPS = 30°，因此 ∠QPR = ∠SPQ - ∠RPS = 60° - 30° = 30°。在三角形 PQR 中，PQ = 3a，PR = √3a，夹角 ∠QPR = 30°。再用余弦定理：QR² = (3a)² + (√3a)² - 2(3a)(√3a)cos30° = 9a² + 3a² - 9a² = 3a²，所以 QR = √3a = PR。因此三角形 PQR 中 PR = QR，底边为 PQ，底角相等，所以 ∠PQR = ∠QPR = 30°。
